primary_setting.global_alignment: confidence-weighted proper Sim3 with iterative 80-percent residual trim
primary_setting.field: per-grid-pixel mean 3-D residual in window-a coordinates
primary_setting.field_fit_support: globally aligned overlap samples retained by the Sim3 trim
primary_setting.shrinkage_selection: leave-one-overlap-frame-out weighted RMSE between window-a and corrected window-b
primary_setting.score_reference: continuous transformed to window-a by an independently fitted overlap Sim3

claim_boundary: Exploratory provider-only restart diagnostic on the already sealed CUT3R R01-R03 prediction bundle. It tests whether a dense local residual fitted without DOT marker coordinates improves agreement with a third CUT3R execution. It is not ground-truth validation, not independent calibration, and not evidence on R04-R70. The marker-level truth-scored experiment was frozen before this diagnostic.
